title: customer-accuracy-regression-calibration-and-quant-policy-override
creator: Marco Rivera
description: Customer (enterprise-acme corp) reported a ~6% drop in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answer accuracy after we rolled out the new FP8 quant profile for their dedicated pool. The customer provided a reproducible eval shard and example prompt set that shows consistent degradation on tail-case prompts. Support requested an emergency calibration run and temporary quant-policy override (pin to INT8 profile) for the customer’s Dedicated node while we validate a corrected profile. This ticket tracks the calibration runs, validation metrics, rollback policy, and follow-ups to make the exception repeatable and auditable.
comments: 2026-02-12 Marco Rivera: Ticket opened after support triage (TKT-87612). Customer dataset attached; initial reproducer shows 6.2% drop in top-1 accuracy vs pre-rollout. Marking as P0 due to production impact.

2026-02-13 Aisha Patel (Runtime): Ran first calibration using existing FP8 profile with customer's seed prompts; observed catastrophic token-entropy spikes on ~3% of sequences. Logged KV cache behavior abnormalities to S3.

2026-02-14 Liam Chen: Created two calibration variants: FP8-conservative (higher dynamic range, looser clipping) and FP8-fine (per-layer per-channel scaling). Also queued an INT8 fallback lane for the customer’s Dedicated pool. Notifying infra for capacity reservation.

2026-02-15 Support (Jade Nguyen): Applied temporary policy override to pin customer to INT8 profile for 24h window; customer confirmed reduction in failures but reported a small latency increase (+12ms p50). Customer accepted temporary measure.

2026-02-17 Marco Rivera: Completed accuracy validation run across the provided eval shard (10k queries). FP8-fine recovered accuracy to within 0.3% of baseline but has higher token variance on long sequences. FP8-conservative still underperforms (~2% below baseline). Collected detailed per-prompt diffs and added to artifacts.

2026-02-18 Security (Rina Kapoor): Reviewed calibration artifacts for sensitive data exposure; all artifacts are redacted and stored in restricted S3 path. No additional controls required for current scope.

2026-02-19 Liam Chen: Drafted rollout plan to promote FP8-fine after one extra night of monitoring. Plan includes canary (5% traffic), metric thresholds (accuracy regression >0.5% or increase in unanswerable rate), and automatic rollback to INT8.
2026-02-20 Product (Ethan Park): Requested follow-up to create a calibration run playbook and a documented exception workflow for enterprise customers. Added a PM follow-up ticket to product board.
acceptance_criteria: FP8-fine profile passes the customer’s 10k query eval with <= 0.5% delta vs pre-rollout baseline
Canary rollout (5% traffic) shows no increase in unanswerable_rate or latency spike beyond SLA for 48h
Calibration artifacts and per-prompt diffs uploaded to S3 and referenced in ticket
Temporary INT8 override remains available as automated rollback for the customer
decision: Promote FP8-fine after controlled canary and monitor; keep INT8 override as short-term safety net. Begin documentation of exception workflow and add automation to generate customer-specific calibration bundles.
